summary: Comprehensive Phase 1 testing completed for La Voix du Chien: 36/36 pytest backend tests PASSED and 11/11 Playwright frontend checks PASSED. All critical flows validated: JWT auth (Bearer + cookies), RBAC (admin/pro/particulier with correct 403s), member approval/reject/suspend lifecycle, dogs CRUD + ownership check, profile update + audit log, notifications isolation per user, mark-all-read, cross-user 404, WS with valid token accepted, admin dashboard KPIs+widget+activity feed, audit filtering, global search scoping, DEMO seed data present, mobile viewport button present, PENDING user shown 'Demande en cours d'examen' screen. No adoption/payment features detected.

minor.issue: Server calls await ws.close(code=4401) before ws.accept(); ASGI/ingress turns this into an HTTP 403 handshake rejection instead of an actual WS close with code 4401. Frontend clients that expect to read the close code cannot see 4401. Fix: `await ws.accept(); await ws.close(code=4401)` if you want the 4401 code exposed to clients.
Uses pydantic EmailStr which rejects reserved TLDs like .local — legitimate but worth documenting; test emails must use real-looking domains.

integration_issues.issue: Browser console shows repeated 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' warnings on every route change. WS actually connects when tested directly with websockets library, so this looks like a client-side reconnect/StrictMode double-mount race. Non-blocking but noisy.

action_items: Optional: fix WS handshake to accept then close(4401) so the frontend can distinguish auth failure from a generic 1006/HTTP 403.
Optional: silence duplicate WS connect warning in NotificationBell (guard against StrictMode double mount / re-connect loops).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py > 700 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, members, notifications, dogs, dashboard) for maintainability.
log_action() runs for every request; consider indexing (user_id, timestamp) for audit query performance at scale.
CORS is `allow_origins=['*']` combined with `allow_credentials=True` — invalid per CORS spec when credentials are used; explicit origin(s) should be configured for production.
resolve_user() silently ignores expired JWT via broad except — fine, but consider logging.
Login lockout key uses `request.client.host` which behind a proxy will be the ingress IP; should honor X-Forwarded-For to avoid locking everyone out.

Only two minor issues remain: (1) WS 4401 close is delivered as HTTP 403 during handshake; (2) NotificationBell WS connects noisily in browser. Future phases (Projets/Tâches/Mindmap/Finances/Terrain) are intentionally absent per spec.
rca of the issue: WS 4401 mismatch RCA: in /app/backend/server.py `ws_notifications` calls `await ws.close(code=4401)` before `await ws.accept()`. Starlette translates a pre-accept close into an ASGI websocket.http.response with status 403, so the client sees a handshake failure, not a WS-level close code. Fix: reorder to accept-then-close if the 4401 code needs to reach the client.
